category_title: Six-year-old girl with PDD-NOS exhibiting behavioral obsessions and communication delays
scenario_title: Non-participation and improper posture during desk activities
minimal_context: The student and teacher are sitting at a desk for a teaching activity using course materials.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our teaching activity. Let's look at these course materials on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits sideways in her chair, holding the 'Lemon Girl' book in her hands and not focusing on the teaching activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look at the materials. Point to the correct answer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Faces away from the teacher and the materials, getting up and sitting down at her desk without responding.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please point to the answer on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws the course materials, gets up from the desk, and does not respond to the discriminative stimulus.)

dialogue_combined:

TUTOR: Please point to the answer on the desk.

STUDENT: (Throws the course materials, gets up from the desk, and does not respond to the discriminative stimulus.)
